text: Fosun International's 2026 interim report lists Fosun Holdings and its parent Fosun International Holdings as its substantial shareholders at 30 June 2026, with 72.78% of the shares; Fosun International Holdings was owned 85.29% by Guo Guangchang and 14.71% by Wang Qunbin. Apart from its directors' own interests, the company says it had not been notified of any other interest that has to be disclosed.
short: Fosun International is 72.78% held by Guo Guangchang's and Wang Qunbin's Fosun International Holdings.

source.name: Fosun International Limited: Interim Report 2026
source.quote: Fosun International Holdings was owned as to 85.29% and 14.71% by Messrs. Guo Guangchang and Wang Qunbin, respectively.
